content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Raipur Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Associate position at NIT Raipur is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. Degree in Mathematics from an Institute of National Importance and have at least two research papers published in SCI/SCIE journals to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 58,800/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Research Associate recruitment at NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post in this recruitment drive by NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur) is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at NIT Raipur is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all relevant educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and self-attested copies of all required documents for the Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.
